structure:
Part 4 of Confluence page "Live Animals & Germinals Data Fields - V4", version 210, read from the tim envelope at workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/sources/6497338582.json (.result.body, storage-format HTML). The slice is bytes 102,284-132,645 of the body: the whole of the h1 section 'Animal Identifiers' (local-id fe4b08ad5cc9) and the whole of the h1 section 'Documents' (local-id 063e74bb0b95), stopping at the h2 'Germinal Data Elements' that opens part 5. Both sections carry no status macro of their own, and the page carries no page-level Draft/Proposed/Superseded macro, so nothing claimed here rests on an unapproved decision.

Layout read in full:
1. h1 'Animal Identifiers' + one intro paragraph (local-id e6c74c02ff1a).
2. The 'Animal Identifiers' table (ac:local-id 31b8faeb-3e91-4363-8dab-381ed2141851), 8 rows: a header row of 8 columns (Field Name | Type | Conditions / Values | Applies at: | Source | Mandatory | Example | Impacts), one full-width colspan-8 banner row ('Animal Identifiers | Field Block - Mandatory to Submit - At least one'), then 6 field rows in order: animal_identifier_passport, animal_identifier_tattoo, animal_identifier_ear_tag, Horse Name (the one row with no anchor macro), animal_identifier_identification_details, animal_identifier_description. Every one of the 6 is Type 'string - max 58', Applies at 'Unit Level', Source 'User', Mandatory 'Optional' and Impacts 'ANIMALS' alone (no GERMINALS marker anywhere in this table).
3. The 4 expand macros nested in the 'Applies at:' cells of this table, each read in full: 'Passport identifier commodities (6)' (9 entries listed), 'Tattoo identifier commodities (2)' (5 entries listed), 'Ear tag identifier commodities (4)' (4 entries listed), 'Horse Name' (1 entry, title states no count). The identification_details and description rows carry no expand: they state a fallback condition instead.
4. h1 'Documents' + one intro paragraph (local-id 2c5298fa90db).
5. The 'Documents' table (ac:local-id 7a84a5d6-1cef-4985-960d-04d69086822e), 6 rows: the same 8-column header row, one full-width colspan-8 banner row ('Accompanying Document | Field Block - Optional - All-or-nothing'), then 4 field rows in order: accompanying_document_type (13 permitted values listed in-cell as a bulleted <code> list), accompanying_document_attachment_type, accompanying_document_reference, accompanying_document_date_of_issue. Every one of the 4 is Applies at 'Notification level', Source 'User', Mandatory 'All-or-nothing' and Impacts 'ANIMALS' and 'GERMINALS' together. No expands in this table.

Covered: the two intro statements, both banner rows quoted exactly, all 6 identifier rows and all 4 document rows column by column (field name, Type, Conditions / Values, Applies at, Source, Mandatory, Example, Impacts), all 4 expands with every entry listed, the two title-versus-list count disagreements (6 vs 9 passport, 2 vs 5 tattoo) as gap claims, the fallback rule the identification_details and description rows state, and the 13 permitted document types in order. Blank or absent values claimed as gaps: Horse Name's Example cell (empty), accompanying_document_reference's Conditions / Values cell (empty), the unlisted set of commodities that have no specific identifier type, the absent upper bound on identifiers per animal, the absent cardinality for accompanying documents, the absent attachment-file field and size limit, the absent date range rule for date of issue, and the document-type Example that is not one of the 13 permitted values. No TBC or 'to be agreed' text appears in this slice (the page's one TBC is in part 2).
